tokenize_code_with_BPE: tokenize Python or Java source code into subword tokens using BPE or RoBERTa models
convert_tokens_to_ids: convert a list of token strings to their corresponding integer IDs using the tokenizer vocabulary
decode_token_ids: decode a list of integer token IDs back into readable source code with optional detokenization
load_pretrained_tokenizer: load a pretrained Java or Python tokenizer from a saved model checkpoint file
create_roberta_tokenizer: create a RoBERTa-based tokenizer for Python or Java code with special token handling
